title: Kestrum
controls_hint: Choose New Game, name your kingdom and choose four to eight factions. Play at a usable 1920 by 1080 canvas. Overview fits known land and returns to your working view.
about: A world waiting for its history. Kestrum is a generational strategy game about kingdoms, armies, and the places their stories leave behind.

Found a human kingdom on the 80-location atlas with a chosen emblem, four to eight factions and a repeatable world seed. Recruit six-slot armies, inspect land routes and supply, build settlements, clear local threats and decide war or peace. Battles and sieges leave persistent casualties, wounds and dated reports.

Service earns classes, formation specializations and recognition. Teach apprentices, form households, raise or adopt dependents and choose qualified successors as people age. Local training focus discounts courses by 25%. Biographies and place histories retain witnessed milestones; rival details come from actual encounters.

Each full round advances one season and creates a checkpoint. Save named copies, reload earlier moments and continue a campaign through its kingdom victory or defeat. The sole design and acceptance canvas is 1920 by 1080. Other host sizes scale or letterbox the same composition; use Full Screen to reach the intended play area.

controls.desc: Expand known map warnings, page through them, and tap a row to focus its place or owned army

Tint shows known political claims; rings show local control. Crown marks your capital, / occupation, X contested control and ? an unknown claim. The lower strip shows current resources and actual last-season accounts
Tap Army, then a destination to move immediately; unfinished routes continue after End Turn
With an army selected, Enter Region exposes local movement and attack targets; World Map returns to the previous world camera
Dismiss the selected place's inspector
Inspect your six-slot rosters, resources, leadership, supply and last round's economy
Open an owned place's work orders, population, facilities, Build, Roads and Focus
Review the prepaid cost, duration and builder; inspect an order to Replace Builder or confirm cancellation
Choose a troop type, review its cost and requirements, then Confirm Recruit
Select your participating armies, choose Assault, Maintain, Withdraw, Sortie or Escape, inspect the risk and Confirm Siege Order
Tap a besieged site with an outside army selected to start relief; the battle opens for preparation
Move Army, transfer the selected formation, open People, inspect recovery or disband with confirmation
Tap an Army marker, then a destination to move now; Move Group selects companions and Review Route inspects saved travel
Menu > Records opens known people, places, armies and battle reports; Search offers a touch keyboard, Events and Filters page recorded history
Review personal class requirements, arrange local lessons or specialize a formation; focused sites show the discounted prepaid cost
Select local people, tap an action to read its requirements, then Confirm order; blocked reviews explain what needs to change
Inspect earned formation XP and personal evidence from army, people and place controls; enemy links show last encountered facts
Choose a co-located recipient; transfers preserve spent movement and remain available during paused rival phases
Pan the map with one finger or the left mouse button
Zoom the map; a mouse wheel also works
Overview fits known land; tap Return View to restore your camera. Recenter focuses your selected army or home. Map Key explains symbols and navigation
Continue saved travel when movement refreshes; a full round advances one season and saves
Pause between rival orders, advance one legal order, or resume progress
Page through saves, load a selected moment, or confirm an overwrite or deletion
Name a separate copy with the visible keyboard; physical typing is optional
Recover from a failed save without repeating completed orders
Open saving, loading, settings, help, and the title screen; Escape also opens the menu
In Manage, rename the place, resettle displaced people, move the capital or relocate headquarters; review costs and Confirm Action
Select an observed local threat or use army Orders, choose adjacent armies, Review Expedition and Confirm Clear Threat
Kingdom on a foreign place or blocked peaceful move opens war and peace options; Menu > Kingdom lists discovered kingdoms
